svg.title: Sujay Adkesar — Digital Forensics & Incident Response
svg.desc: Sujay Adkesar. DFIR Analyst · Windows & mobile forensics · IR tooling. I build open-source tools that automate the repetitive part of an examination — and trace every finding to the byte it came from. Illustration: a forensic workstation carving file signatures (E01, NTFS, $MFT, regf, SQLite) from a disk image, verifying its SHA-256 hash, and a 24-hour super-timeline with a USB connection and an Eraser execution flagged.
